subject: AP policy: ClarionTech vendor setup & early-pay proposal
body:
From: Jenny Wu <jenny.wu@clariontech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@clariontech.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + early-pay discount request

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. We're ready to get ClarionTech set up in your PO flow — two quick items from our side:

1) Payment terms: our standard is Net 45, but we can be flexible. For larger partners we can offer an early-pay discount of 1.5% if paid within 10 days.
2) Vendor setup: attached the W9 and our AP terms spreadsheet. Can you confirm the PO process and whether Redwood can accept VendorNet terms on the first PO?

Attached: ClarionTech_W9.pdf and ClarionTech_AP-terms-202705.xlsx

Can you loop in whoever manages vendor setup and AP? Appreciate it.

Best,
Jenny Wu
Director, Finance Operations
ClarionTech, Inc.

---

On Wed, 19 May 2027 at 09:12 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Jenny Wu <jenny.wu@clariontech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + early-pay discount request

Hi Jenny — thanks, received the W9 and AP spreadsheet.

Quick internal note: looping in Marissa (billing/payments) and Karthik (vendor onboarding). Two things we need to confirm internally before we can commit:
- Standard Redwood net term for new vendors by default is Net 60 for third-party contractors; exceptions for strategic partners or volume-based deals (can be Net 30/45).
- Early-pay discounts are evaluated on a case-by-case basis; Finance typically does up to 1.0% for a 10-day window unless there is a compelling margin case.

Jenny — would Clarion accept 1.0% for 10 days as a starting point, or is 1.5% a hard requirement? Also, can you confirm your preferred remittance details for Stripe/ACH?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

On Wed, 19 May 2027 at 09:34 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + early-pay discount request

Logan — thanks for the heads up. A few notes from AP side that will determine what we can do:
- Vendor risk: ClarionTech is new; we need completed vendor packet + PO test to open Net 45.
- Discount: standard finance policy allows up to 1.0% for T+10 on vendor enrollment for recurring supplier invoices; approving 1.5% requires CFO sign-off.
- If they want Net 45 with a 1.5% early pay, we can offer Net 45 + 1.0% early-pay now while we route the 1.5% request to the CFO for consideration.

I'll need the signed vendor form, ACH details, and a copy of the first invoice mapped to a PO number. If we do Net 45, AP will set the payment due date accordingly; early-pay discounts are applied at payment-time via our AP workflow.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Billing & Collections
Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, 20 May 2027 at 11:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + early-pay discount request

Logan/Marissa — happy to manage vendor packet. Proposed operational steps:
1) Send ClarionTech a short vendor setup form via secure link (I put a draft on Drive).
2) Once W9 + signed vendor form + ACH details received, create vendor record and run tax/AML checks (48 hours).
3) Issue a test PO (non-financial) to validate routing and invoice fields.
4) After successful PO test, enable Net 45 and configure early-pay workflow (if approved).

If Clarion needs faster time-to-pay, we can prioritize the checks for an expedited setup (one business day) but need confirmation they accept 1.0% for T+10 while we route the 1.5% ask to Finance.

I'll share the secure form link when ready.

Karthik
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

---

On Fri, 21 May 2027 at 10:15 AM Jenny Wu <jenny.wu@clariontech.com> wrote:
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@clariontech.com>, Matthew Perez <matthew.perez@clariontech.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + early-pay discount request

Thanks for the clarity. ClarionTech can accept 1.0% for T+10 as a temporary measure while you route the 1.5% to your CFO. We'd like an expedited vendor setup if possible — we have an initial invoice to attach once the PO is active.

Attached: Invoice_124.pdf

Please send the secure vendor form link and the DocuSign to authorize the early-pay enrollment.

Best,
Jenny

---

On Sat, 22 May 2027 at 16:45:00 -0700 Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Jenny Wu <jenny.wu@clariontech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + early-pay discount request

Jenny — good news. We can proceed with the expedited setup and make the following temporary commitments while we route finance approval for a permanent 1.5% program:

- Enable vendor record and Net 45 payment terms after we receive the signed vendor form, ACH details, and the invoice mapped to PO_000874 (we will create PO_000874 as the test PO)
- Apply a 1.0% early-pay discount for payments made within 10 calendar days (T+10) for the initial three invoices; Finance will review after that window for potential 1.5% approval
- We will provide a secure vendor setup link and a DocuSign envelope for the early-pay enrollment.

Action items for ClarionTech:
- Complete vendor form: https://redwood.app/drive/vendor-forms/clariontech-setup
- Sign early-pay DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC1234567890
- Send ACH/remit confirmation to ap@redwood.ai
- Map next invoice to PO_000874 and upload to invoices@redwood.ai once the PO is received

If you complete those today we can try to get PO_000874 into the system Monday morning and process invoice_124 on Net 45 terms with the applied T+10 1.0% early-pay discount.

I'll mark this thread with deal id ACCT-CLAR-2027-044 and hand off to Marissa for the Po creation and verification.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

-- 
Attachments referenced: ClarionTech_W9.pdf (pdf), ClarionTech_AP-terms-202705.xlsx (xlsx), Invoice_124.pdf (pdf)
